My background is at the intersection of engineering, product, and organizational psychology. Software is a team sport and I'm building Skillsync to bring the best out of engineering teams!

founders.name: Jimmy Wei
founders.bio: Chiehmin (Jimmy) Wei is a co-founder of IncidentFox. Before IncidentFox, Jimmy was a software engineer at Roblox, where he architected a real-time communication feature reaching 11.7M+ users, and at Facebook AI Research (FAIR), where he built conversational AI infrastructure and set new research baselines with Transformer models. He holds an M.S. from Cornell University and a B.S. in Computer Science from Bucknell University.

founders.name: Long Yi
founders.bio: Long Yi is the co-founder of IncidentFox, an AI-powered SRE platform for automated incident investigation and infrastructure management. Previously, he built large-scale distributed systems at Roblox, managing database and search infrastructure handling over 1.5 million queries per second. He holds a B.S. from Brandeis University, where he conducted research in audiovisual signal processing and neural modeling.
